blends.name: Project Phoenix Raffle Ticket
blends.desc:
# **Project Phoenix**

**Help UFA rise from the ashes as we bury the the hatchet and move forward from the past!**

Sadly, longer ago, a person used their access to the Upland Fan Art collection to make an inflammatory NFT that was not supported by the UFA owners and artists.  The NFT was sent to wallets inappropriately and lead to the loss of verification status for the collection.  This is an attempt by UFA to burn these assets and start off with a clean slate.

These tickets will be redeemable for chances at Upland Assets.  With the rise of legits, decor, and even cars in Upland, there are tons of ways to reward those that help UFA to clear out as many of these unwelcome NFTs as possible.  A final list of potential prizes will be provided by UPX World.  To learn more check out the UPX World discord server.

[UPX World Discord](https://discord.gg/upxworld)
